fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Section Controller Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) will release the notification for the RRB CEN 03/2026 recruitment of Section Controller posts on its official website. The online application process for RRB Section Controller Recruitment 2026 will start from 15 July 2026 & the candidates can apply until 14 August 2026. Total of 119 vacancies have been announced for Section Controller posts under RRB Section Controller CEN 03/2026 Recruitment. Candidates must check the Complete details for RRB Section Controller Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 July 2026
  • Last Date : 14 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 August 2026
  • Form Corrections Last Date : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Minorities / 3rd Gender : Rs. 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
  • SC,  ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Railway RRB Section Controller Online Form 2026?

Railway RRB Section Controller Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 14 August 2026.

The official website is: https://indianrailways.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
